item.title: Apollo v4.0.0
item.description:
Apollo 4.0.0 | Apollo-Reborn-4.0.0
### Features
- Add **iPhone Duo** support with layouts that adapt to the closed display, open portrait, open landscape and partially folded positions, using the existing Apollo Reborn builds (#1245: @IllIIllIllIllII) - Browse a feed beside its comments, choose Original or Focused content widths, and open the subreddit list in a Standard or Liquid Glass panel - Inbox, Account and Settings gain sidebar/detail layouts in open landscape, while Search can keep results beside the page you open - Pixel Pals is unavailable on Duo; regular iPhones keep it - Add an optional **iPad Layout (Beta)** on iPadOS 18 and later, with a native sidebar, adjustable feed and reader columns, and full-width Gallery View (#1385: @jordanearle) - Try it from the one-time invitation or turn on iPad Layout under Interface; quit and reopen Apollo to apply it, or turn it off to return to the classic layout - Add **Restore Reading Session** to reopen your last feed, post and nearby reading position after iOS closes Apollo, including feed and comment sorting (#1441: @Thetromboneman1) - On by default under Media → Browsing; explicit links and notifications take priority, and turning it off deletes the saved session - Add a **Setup Assistant** for new installations to connect or restore, choose Classic, Balanced or Full Featured preferences, select appearance, and review before applying (#1401: @jordanearle) - Existing users can open it from Apollo Reborn settings with Keep My Settings selected; updating does not automatically apply a preset - Rework **Gallery View** with faster opening, pinch-to-resize tiles including a denser four-column layout, and native press-and-hold menus in the grid and fullscreen viewer (#1389, #1434: @icpryde, @IllIIllIllIllII) - Sports clips can play silently in the grid, newly visible tiles start reliably, and returning from a fullscreen image no longer leaves a black screen - Open **Gallery View** for All Saved or a selected **Saved category**, with empty categories shown without an endless spinner (#1440: @IllIIllIllIllII) - Rebuild **Recently Read** as a native Apollo feed that follows your post layout, thumbnails, text size, themes, swipe actions and menus (#1442: @IllIIllIllIllII) - Open it from its own row on your profile, switch its layout without changing other feeds, clear the history, or remove individual posts - Add **Recently Visited** subreddits to Search, with configurable section order and limits under Subreddits settings (#1404: @IllIIllIllIllII) - History clears on restart or account change and is not saved to backups - Add **Add Downvote Tap** under Posts & Feeds → Info Row so tapping a score can cycle through upvote, downvote and no vote; off by default (#1403: @AcornElf) - Add a **Subreddit Icon** switch to Compact and Immersive subreddit header layouts, updating the preview and live header together (#1426: @IllIIllIllIllII) - Feature seasonal icons in **Daily Spotlight** around holidays, including Apollo's original holiday icons; the spotlight now shows six picks (#1390, #1245: @icpryde, @IllIIllIllIllII) - Tint **Apollo Reborn maintainer usernames** purple in posts, comments and the Inbox, while retaining their real profiles and normal moderator indicators (#1411: @IllIIllIllIllII) - Make **Bug Reports** attach a removable debug log automatically, and mask usernames, account details, links and sensitive values before logs are exported or shared (#1422, #1423: @icpryde) - Export Debug Logs now shares a file that can be attached on GitHub; subreddit names, post/comment IDs and diagnostic details remain readable
### Performance
- Reduce unnecessary **API-Key-Free** requests by fetching subscriptions in larger pages and, with Reduce Rate Limiting on, batching feed avatars by page; interrupted subscription refreshes keep the existing list (#1416: @icpryde) - Deleted or unavailable Bluesky previews stop repeatedly fetching themselves and using Reddit requests as a fallback
### Fixes
- Refine **Duo navigation** with steadier feed positions and search bars when columns change, a smoother subreddit drawer, correct Home/Popular/All restoration, and Reddit links opened from Settings routed to Posts (#1470: @nnastasi) - Resume videos that were playing before folding or unfolding, covering both shared Reddit videos and direct-player media - Center **folded Duo title pills** in the usable header and keep composer text clear of the right-hand system strip, with correct wrapping and height through folding and unfolding (#1480: @jordanearle) - Keep the same **Duo comments thread** when returning from a linked subreddit after rotation or folding, and let the drawer return to an older retained feed correctly (#1464: @jordanearle) - Correct **Duo video autoplay** around the side rail and both columns' navigation bars (#1466: @kiliantyler) - Keep **View All Comments** visible inside its Duo comments pane when opening a specific comment (#1468: @d0lb33) - Stop the hidden **subreddit index** swallowing favorite taps and scrolling near the stars on Duo (#1469: @kiliantyler) - Open **native action menus** from controls moved into UIKit's overflow menu instead of silently dismissing without showing the actions (#1474: @kiliantyler) - Keep loading **API-Key-Free Inbox** rows when looking up a reply's quoted parent fails, showing the messages without that quote (#1455: @icpryde, @DeltAndy123) - Keep **API-Key-Free infinite scrolling** retryable after Reddit returns a rate limit or block page, rather than treating the refusal as the end of the feed (#1424: @icpryde) - Load the next feed page when **Hide Read** hides every loaded post, including with Infinite Scrolling off (#1412: @icpryde) - Fix **Reddit image uploads** becoming broken links when Imgur is selected, single-photo comment uploads failing, and synthetic album links in comments (#1402, #1406: @jordanearle, @IllIIllIllIllII) - Previously broken uploads still need to be uploaded again - Give **inline comment images and GIFs** Copy Image, Save Image and Share actions, and open loaded images fullscreen without a second loading fade (#1400: @IllIIllIllIllII) - Show the correct **image, GIF, video and album menus** when pressing and holding media inside a post, including Save All Media for albums (#1435: @IllIIllIllIllII) - Fix a crash when opening a **compact album** from its long-press preview (#1398: @IllIIllIllIllII) - Fix crashes while **feed videos** wait to play and while **deleted comments** are being prepared (#1428, #1450: @Thetromboneman1) - Keep a playing **feed video's sound and mute icon** in step when opening its post, including with the phone's silent switch on (#1425: @icpryde) - Stop **rich link cards** shifting the feed or changing their image crop after voting (#1457: @icpryde) - Open **Find in Comments** from the Liquid Glass post menu with its search field, keyboard and result navigation working correctly (#1446: @icpryde) - Keep a collapsed **feed search bar** hidden when returning from the fullscreen image viewer (#1447: @Thetromboneman1) - Bring back the complete **Liquid Glass tab bar** after swiping back from Edit Profile, including its glass background (#1431: @icpryde) - Refresh **subreddit icons and banners** from current Reddit artwork instead of retaining older images (#1396: @IllIIllIllIllII) - Preserve **usernames in comment and post headers** by shortening flair first, while keeping timestamps and other trailing details visible (#1366: @AcornElf) - Open **Reddit social links** on profiles directly in Apollo instead of the browser (#1407: @IllIIllIllIllII) - Explain why **Notifications settings** are unavailable when no notification backend is configured, instead of spinning forever (#1399: @IllIIllIllIllII) - Open **Poll, Media, Link and Text** post shortcuts in the correct editor even when the composer finishes preparing after its sheet appears (#1414: @IllIIllIllIllII) - Keep the separator below **Home's first post** visible after switchi…
